facts.fact: Alleles and Cre driver of the original KC model
facts.value: Endogenous KrasG12D switched on in progenitor cells of the mouse pancreas (the abstract does not name the Cre driver; Pdx1-Cre and p48/Ptf1a-Cre are the drivers named elsewhere)
Ductal lesions covering the whole human PanIN spectrum, highly proliferative, showing histological progression; a few progress on their own to invasive and metastatic adenocarcinoma
Mice with PanINs had a recognisable serum proteomic pattern, suggested as a way to detect the preinvasive state

facts.fact: Low rate of cancer in KC
facts.value: KC mice show mostly PanIN at about 4 months and visible terminal PDAC only at about 10 months
facts.where: Results, first section; Fig. 1D legend; Fig. 3A

facts.value: Within a 6-month observation period more than 76% of KC mice stayed free of PDAC

facts.fact: Alleles and Cre driver of classic KPC
facts.value: LSL-KrasG12D/+ with LSL-Trp53R172H/+ and Pdx1-Cre (Nature 2025 also uses Ptf1a-Cre;lsl-KrasG12D;Trp53R172H/+ and calls it KPC)

facts.fact: Original description (as given in the abstract)
facts.value: Hingorani 2005 reports that Trp53R172H and KrasG12D together give invasive, widely metastatic PDAC that reproduces the human disease
Primary tumours and metastases show many non-reciprocal chromosomal translocations without obvious telomere erosion; the abstract says this resembles human carcinomas and is unusual in mice
No mutations were found in other main tumour suppressor pathways, which the authors take to mean there are separate genetic routes to PDA with different behaviour
Later authors call KPC the standard mouse model of metastatic PDAC that matches many features of the human disease
In KPC mice examined at 6, 10 and 15 weeks, PanIN appeared after 6 weeks; PanIN2-3 became more common by 15 weeks in mice that also lacked Cyrib
H&E of normal duct, PanIN1, PanIN2, PanIN3 and PDAC from KPC mice (Fig. 3A, scale bar 100 um)
187 days in KPC (118 days with Cyrib deleted)
KPC mice develop metastases in liver, diaphragm and bowel; Fig. 4A gives the fraction for each site in n=21 KPC and CKPC mice (exact fractions are in the figure, not read here)

facts.fact: Time frame in the PIKfyve study
facts.value: KPC mice analysed at 25 weeks had pancreata with a mix of normal, PanIN and PDAC tissue; a typical figure shows healthy, PanIN and PDAC regions in one pancreas

facts.fact: Histology of KPC PDAC in a stated section
facts.value: Invasive glands with atypical nuclei in desmoplastic stroma (own description of Fig. 1a PDAC panel)

facts.fact: Related model with R270H, not classic KPC
facts.value: Park 2019 uses KrasG12D; Trp53R270H/+; Pdx1-Cre; KPC median tumour-free survival 24.6 weeks (n=28), shorter with Palb2, Brca1 or Brca2 loss (10.1, 11.9, 13.7 weeks)

facts.fact: Cystic lesions with Palb2/Brca1 loss in KPC (R270H)
facts.value: Grossly visible cysts up to about 3 cm, often in body and tail, resembling mucinous cystic neoplasm and surrounded by ovarian-like stroma that stained for oestrogen and progesterone receptors; present in 6 of 23 Palb2-KPC animals and in most Brca1-KPC animals

facts.fact: Original description (as given in the abstract)
facts.value: Izeradjene 2007: KrasG12D together with loss of one copy of Smad4/Dpc4 yields a different class of tumour, mucinous cystic neoplasm (MCN), which goes on to invasive ductal adenocarcinoma
MCN pathway is called analogous to but distinct from PanIN-to-PDAC, with a markedly different prognosis; progression is accompanied by LOH of Dpc4 and mutation of p53 or p16
The order and setting in which the same mutations arrive shape the resulting pathology

facts.fact: How a later open paper summarises Kras;Smad4 (called KSC)
facts.value: KrasG12D plus Smad4 deletion gives mostly IPMN-type lesions that can progress to invasive PDAC but with much slower onset and less metastasis than KPC or KIC

facts.fact: Cre and alleles in the JCB paper
facts.value: Pdx1-Cre with LSL-KrasG12D and Smad4fl/fl (called KSC); KPC, KIC and KC mice were made as comparators; Smad4fl/fl, Trp53fl/fl and other floxed lines came from Jackson Laboratories

facts.fact: Gross and microscopic lesions in KSC
facts.value: Mostly macroscopic cystic lesions that the authors call IPMN-like by overall architecture, strong Muc5AC and CK19 staining, and Alcian blue positivity; at 4 months
KSC tumour-free survival was longer than KPC and KIC; 90% of KSC mice had no PDAC or death within the observation period (to about 4 months), n=45
KSC cancers stay well differentiated with little change in E-cadherin or vimentin and no metastasis was seen even in terminal PDAC; cited as agreeing with earlier work
The JCB paper treats these as IPMN-like (cystic, Muc5AC-rich) whereas Izeradjene 2007 calls them MCN; both refer to Kras with Smad4 loss

Fig. 7 compares KC, KSC, KSPrC and Kras;TbetaRII-deleted mice at 1 to 4 months with H&E, Alcian blue, CK19, Muc5AC; the paper states that removing Prdm16 and Smad4 together reproduces TGF-beta receptor loss

facts.value: Tgfbr2 inactivation in Ptf1aCre/+;KrasLSL-G12D/+;Rosa26-Cas9 mice sped up acinar dedifferentiation by 8 weeks (H&E)
